data.narrative:
Reflex Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of nine private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing—including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics—plus one public comparable (277810.KQ).

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($7M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $18M. Peer-median analysis was not feasible; while the Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains ten same-sector peers, insufficient overlap exists at the same stage and comparable valuation tier to satisfy minimum sample requirements (n≥3). Drawing on all-sector peers would introduce unwarranted noise given the narrow peer set meeting stage and size criteria.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M (low) to $20M (high), with a median point of $18M. This range reflects the stage-progression calculation and reasonable sensitivity around the 2.5x multiplier assumption. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the step-up multiple for this company's specific cohort and the thinness of available Seed-stage comparables in the robotics vertical. Additional data on peer financing terms and downstream funding outcomes would strengthen conviction in the range.
